slots.sentence: During a hearing in June, defense attorney Jessica Carmichael said Rush wasn’t charged initially with any crimes related to the discovery of the gold bars, which she referred to as “basically a nonissue” and “nothing more than a sensational tidbit.”

slots.sentence: “Mr. Rush never claimed they were his,” Carmichael said.
